# Commands Implement/Try recovery and visible style evidence

`commands/graph/client/implement.js` renders both the new `styleChecks` and legacy `patchContext.validation.style`; when neither exists it says no style evidence was recorded. Focused validation: 45 workflow tests, 2 browser tests, ESLint, and `git diff --check`. [Task 2]

Scope: console.
